# Module: `icescopy_inptk_data`

Converts in-memory freeze counts and sample metadata into toolkit input records.

[Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_data.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Validates paired total/frozen columns, count values, and sample metadata. Uses each sample's corrected temperature when present, otherwise the shared temperature, and records rows skipped for missing temperature or cycle. Upload helpers select group members and assigned water blanks, omitting dilution and air/soil fields for blanks.
